typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATA_CENTER_NAME as string,
		OPERATION_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		INSTALL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		LOCATION_NAME as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE_PROVINCE as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID as string,
		MAINFRAME_ID as string,
		END_OF_LIFE_DATE as timestamp,
		RISK_ASSESSMENT_NUMBER as string,
		TECHNOLOGY_PLAN_NAME as string,
		APPLICATION_LINE_OF_BUSINESS as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_WF_GUID as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_NAME as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_VIRTUAL_FLAG as string,
		ZIP_POSTAL_CODE as string,
		MAC5_LOCATION as string,
		PRIMARYAPP as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_INSTALL_STATUS as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_GUID as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_NAME as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		TODSH_DELETE_FLAG as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EXPIRY_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MAC5_LOCATION as string,
		DATA_CENTER_NAME as string,
		END_OF_LIFE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_NAME as string,
		INSTALL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		OPERATION_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		TODSH_DELETE_FLAG as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		ZIP_POSTAL_CODE as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_GUID as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_WF_GUID as string,
		MAINFRAME_ID as string,
		RISK_ASSESSMENT_NUMBER as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EXPIRY_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DIRECT_SERVER_NAME as string,
		DIRECT_SERVER_VIRTUAL_FLAG as string,
		PRIMARY_APP_INSTALL_STATUS as string,
		PRIMARYAPP as string,
		CITY as string,
		DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID as string,
		TECHNOLOGY_PLAN_NAME as string,
		APPLICATION_LINE_OF_BUSINESS as string,
		STATE_PROVINCE as string,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		LOCATION_NAME as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MAC5_LOCATION,
		DATA_CENTER_NAME,
		END_OF_LIFE_DATE,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_NAME,
		INSTALL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		OPERATION_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		TODSH_DELETE_FLAG,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME,
		ZIP_POSTAL_CODE,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_GUID,
		PRIMARY_APP_DISTRIBUTED_ID,
		APPLICATION_NAME,
		DIRECT_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		DIRECT_SERVER_WF_GUID,
		MAINFRAME_ID,
		RISK_ASSESSMENT_NUMBER,
		ImportDate,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EXPIRY_DATE,
		DIRECT_SERVER_NAME,
		DIRECT_SERVER_VIRTUAL_FLAG,
		PRIMARY_APP_INSTALL_STATUS,
		PRIMARYAPP,
		CITY,
		DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID,
		TECHNOLOGY_PLAN_NAME,
		APPLICATION_LINE_OF_BUSINESS,
		STATE_PROVINCE,
		PHYSICAL_SERVER_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		LOCATION_NAME,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
